title: Water price to rise from April 2024; Government to provide support for lower- and middle-income households
archive_note: Text rendering of the page, not the publisher's original HTML file — recorded as an extract for that reason. Annex A is a real HTML table in the source, so the figures are machine-readable. That is the whole difference from pub-water-price, whose rate table is an image.
establishes: Domestic water tariff from 1 April 2025: 1.43 below 40 m3/month, 1.81 above
Waterborne Tax from 1 April 2025: 1.09 below 40 m3/month, 1.40 above
Water Conservation Tax rule: 50% of tariff below 40 m3/month, 65% above
does_not_establish: The rounding stage of the Water Conservation Tax. Annex A prints 0.72 in a row labelled '(% of Tariff)'; the stated rule gives 0.715. Precedence puts the formula above the presentation table, and only an invoice shows what is actually billed.
That the rates remain in force. This release announces a future revision; currency is evidenced by sp-tariff-information.
